info.name: Worldline Card Issuing Account - AccountState Retrieve transaction totals API

params.name: levelId
params.description: Any ID of a level of the Equens contract administration

params.name: levelIdValue
params.description:
ID value at this level.
Example value
clusterId 1000,
merchantId 2000,
contractId 3000,
siteId 4000,
terminalId 5000

params.name: type
params.description:
Transaction type Filter. 
Values (optional):
purchase, refund or chargeback

items.docs:
This operation of the Analysis API will help you to retrieve daily aggregated totals.
You can do this using by providing an entity from the equensWorldline contract hierarchy, such as a contractId. 
The results are aggregated transaction numbers and revenue on a daily basis, divided by type Purchases, refunds and chargebacks.
